question: Which of the following states inaugurated its first bird festival ‘Kalrav’ in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

__
 
• **Bihar states inaugurated its first bird festival ‘Kalrav’ in January 2021**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bird sanctuaries in Bihar are:**

 
 
• Salim Ali-Jubba Sahni Bird Sanctuary.
 
• Pant Wildlife Sanctuary.
 
• Kanwar Lake Bird Sanctuary.
 
• Nagi Bird Sanctuary.
